finding.title: Split 4 oversized settings-feature test files over the 400-line AG-3 cap
finding.why: AG-3's stated checker (`find lib test -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'`) would flag all 4 files (1499, 1087, 842, 604 lines). scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart alone bundles tests for 3 unrelated screens (ScopeSelectionScreen, LifetimeMarkingScreen, LifetimeCurriculumMarkingScreen) in one file, which is exactly the 'dumping ground' failure mode AG-3 names — a future editor grepping for one screen's tests has to read past the other two to find the relevant group.
finding.recommendation: Split scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart along its 3 existing screen-boundary comment headers into 3 files; split the other 3 along their existing top-level group() boundaries (e.g. account_actions_test.dart into sign-out vs delete-account-flow files).
acceptance_criteria: `find learning_tracker/lib learning_tracker/test -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'` no longer lists these 4 files.
No testWidgets case is deleted in the split — only relocated.

finding.title: Fix 7 stale 'HARDCODED STRING' comments in upgrade_to_cloud_screen_l1_test.dart — the strings are l10n-sourced now
finding.rule: AG-8-adjacent (comments must not misrepresent current source state) / AX-2

evidence.quote: // HARDCODED STRING: "Confirm your password" is not sourced from l10n.
// HARDCODED STRING: "You're signed in as …" body text is hardcoded.
// HARDCODED STRING: "Password required" is hardcoded in the validator.
// HARDCODED STRING: this message is hardcoded in _submit().
// HARDCODED STRING: "Incorrect password." is hardcoded in the catch block.
// HARDCODED STRING: internet error message is hardcoded.
// HARDCODED STRING: "You're backed up!" in _SuccessBlock is not l10n-sourced.

finding.why: None of the 7 strings these comments call out as hardcoded actually appear as literals in upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart — grepping the source finds zero hits, and every one is confirmed sourced from a matching AppLocalizations getter with an identical English ARB value (e.g. app_en.arb:1514 upgradeToCloudPasswordLabel = 'Confirm your password', :1526 upgradeToCloudSuccessTitle = "You're backed up!"). The code was fixed in an earlier wave but these test comments were never updated, so they now misrepresent the file's current AX-2 compliance to the next reader/agent — who might waste time 'fixing' a non-issue or, worse, assume any future l10n regression here is 'already known'.
finding.recommendation: Delete or correct the 7 comments to note the strings are AppLocalizations-sourced (cite the ARB keys), so the file accurately documents current state.
acceptance_criteria: None of the 7 comments in upgrade_to_cloud_screen_l1_test.dart claim a string is hardcoded/not-l10n-sourced when grepping upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart shows it is.

finding.title: Close the in-memory UserDatabase created inline in settings test ProviderScope overrides
finding.rule: TQ-6-adjacent (test resource hygiene / Nygard: unreleased I/O resource)
finding.why: _sheetOverrides / _buildApp in these 4 files each construct `UserDatabase(NativeDatabase.memory())` inline and never capture a reference to close it — unlike the `DeviceRegistryDatabase` created in the same functions, which is correctly torn down via `addTearDown(registry.close)` (verified by grep: registry.close appears, db.close never does, in any of the 4 files). account_actions_test.dart alone calls its factory from ~19 separate testWidgets cases, so a single run of just this batch leaks on the order of 25+ native SQLite (FFI) connections that are never released.
finding.recommendation: Capture the constructed UserDatabase into a local variable in each factory and close it via addTearDown(db.close) or the existing tearDown, mirroring the registry.close() pattern already present in the same 4 functions.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 4 files' UserDatabase(NativeDatabase.memory()) instances is closed by the end of every test that constructs one.

finding.title: Rename account_actions_sheet_nav_test.dart's single-account Sign Out test — title claims SignInRoute, assertion checks AccountPickerRoute
finding.rule: TQ-8 / Evans ubiquitous-language consistency (test name must match what it verifies)

evidence.quote: 'Sign Out (single account) → root router.replaceAll([SignInRoute]) — no regression',

finding.why: The testWidgets title says the single-account sign-out case routes to SignInRoute, but the assertion checks AccountPickerRoute — and the test's own inline comment (lines 268-270) shows the author caught the discrepancy while writing it ('Single account: getAllAccounts returns 1 → still AccountPicker path? No — sign-out keeps the account row; the picker is correct with ≥1... The SignInRoute branch is the EMPTY-registry case, covered below') but never renamed the test string. A reader skimming test names for the routing invariant would learn the wrong rule.
finding.recommendation: Rename the test to 'Sign Out (single account) → root router.replaceAll([AccountPickerRoute])' to match its assertion.
acceptance_criteria: The test's title string matches the route type its expect() checks.

finding.title: Use DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() instead of raw DateTime.now() in scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart and backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart
finding.why: scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart (6 occurrences: lines 419,420,430,431,446,447) and backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart (2: lines 121,157) seed DB rows / SyncStatus values with raw `DateTime.now().toUtc()`, even though the sibling file settings_screen_r5_regression_test.dart's `_dbWithProfile` in the same feature directory already uses the project's `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` for the identical FK-seeding purpose. TQ-6 is Enforced for lib/ specifically because wall-clock reads are a live nondeterminism source under parallel/randomized test ordering; extending that discipline to test/ is explicitly named as the pending next step, and this batch shows the established in-feature alternative being ignored, not just an isolated slip.
finding.recommendation: Replace the 8 call sites with DateTimeFactory.nowUtc(), matching settings_screen_r5_regression_test.dart's convention.
acceptance_criteria: No DateTime.now() call remains in scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart or backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart; both use DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() or a fixed DateTime.utc(...) literal.
